description: Returns report.json of a finished run (completed, failed or cancelled): the verdict and the evidence. Read-only; never publishes. Runs `devflow report <run> --json`.

run.description: Run id, as returned by devflow_plan, devflow_analyze or devflow_status.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace (the repository root). Default: the directory the MCP server was started in.

name: devflow_report
title: Read the report of a finished run
